item.title: SCP-4513:
item.content:encoded:
CHUCK TINGLE IM WHEEZING

I’m really curious about what other effects can be created by this thing, though. I think it’s hysterical how all the books ended up being about taxes, but the ability to hybridize the themes of literature is pretty fascinating in itself.

item.title: SCP-4048:
item.content:encoded: This is hilarious, I love it. It grabbed me immediately from the beginning with the mention of forklift certifications, and then…it turns out that the aliens are just really concerned with forklifts?

item.title: SCP-5644: +1
item.content:encoded: Good dialogue in my opinion. As someone who struggles with dialogue in particular, this was fairly impressive. Found a few mistakes with grammar and a few XXXXs left in, so you might want to fix those. Article did a good job of conveying information and story, although I think the description could be more clinical. A unique and interesting SCP as well. Earns my upvote. Looking forward to maybe seeing other interesting takes on ancient gods in the future.

item.title: SCP-5004: what the hell did i just read
item.content:encoded: This is an incredibly wacky shitpost, but most of it isn't in a style I enjoyed. The humor and dialogue in particular were mostly a miss for me. There were several boring parts that I had to skim through, but I enjoyed some of it. Overall, I feel like I've been hit with a mind-warping cognitohazard. -1.

item.title: SCP-874:
item.content:encoded: So it's a…scary hole that makes people suicidal? There seems to be too much tropey stuff going on here, with the inability to remove one's limbs from the hole, the mysterious injuries, and the suicidality, that makes it seem more cliche than genuinely scary.

item.title: SCP-1093:
item.content:encoded: Anyone else thinking that the "auditory hallucinations" are its attempts to communicate? Not sure if that was the intended implication or just my interpretation. item.title: SCP-231: +1
item.content:encoded: Stomach-turning, mostly in its lack of clarity about what happens to the girl. "Unspecified horrific thing" isn't always effective but there is enough detail here to suggest the horrific thing without spelling it out. Leaves me feeling icky, but compelling.

item.title: SCP-5004: Provides Much Needed Laughs
item.content:encoded:
Given the state that the world is in, this SCP provided some much needed medication in the form of some good laughs.

From the description of Old Gorman ("not the broom! Anything but the broom!"), the dialogue leading up to the election, to Foundation personnel finding that don't quite have political immunity following the Comey incident and Russia's suspected involvement, to Supreme Motherfucking Sorceress Extraordinaire Notorious Justice Ruth Bade Ginsberg kicking said Gorman's ass, this was hilarious.

There were one or two parts that were a bit tiring, such as the brainless dialogue from the Trumps, but for the most part, this was entertaining from start to finish.

item.title: SCP-1730:
item.content:encoded: I think I am missing something- I'm not sure why the expedition members perceive themselves to be dead at the end? But this was suspenseful enough to keep me reading even though i usually lose interest in the longer articles.
